label: English-taught programmes at a Greek public university: apply to the programme, 2027

milestones.label: University of Athens BA in Ancient Greece: applications close
Other English-taught programmes
milestones.note: Each programme sets its own date; some are rolling. Aristotle University's Clean Energy degree takes applications year-round for September 2027, in order of receipt, with registration by 30 September 2027. About twenty English-taught bachelor's at ten public universities were listed on Study in Greece in September 2026.

supplementarySteps: Find the programme first, on the Study in Greece platform (apply.studyingreece.edu.gr). Most Greek public universities still teach bachelor programmes only in Greek.
Apply on the programme's own site. The IB is accepted directly, with no Panhellenic exams. These programmes charge tuition.

notes: Shares the gr-public jurisdiction with gr-minedu-foreign-2027. The same university can have Greek-taught places through the ministry and English-taught places applied for directly.
